Lots of luggage：Magok is a new district with wide roads, just a short distance from Gimpo Airport.
Wheelchair use：Available at no extra charge. The driver helps with loading the wheelchair and getting in and out.
Solo travelers：Genesis VIP transfers are also available. Please contact us for the price.
Estimated hotel arrival by flight time

From Incheon Airport, we cross the Yeongjong Bridge or Incheon Bridge and enter Seoul on the Incheon International Airport Expressway. To reach Magok we usually continue on Olympic-daero (south of the Han River), and we detour onto city streets when the riverside road is busy.
9:00 arrival：at your Magok hotel around 10:50
13:00 arrival：at your Magok hotel around 14:50
17:00 arrival：at your Magok hotel around 18:50
21:00 arrival：at your Magok hotel around 22:40
23:00 arrival：at your Magok hotel around 0:40
These estimates allow about 50 minutes for immigration and baggage claim, and multiply daytime drive times by 1.4 for traffic.
About the Magok area

A new district just east of Gimpo Airport, home to Botanic Park, the Mayfield Hotel and LG Science Park. Main sights include Seoul Botanic Park, Magoknaru Station and Balsan Station. Nearby areas are Yeongdeungpo (about 9.1 km), Hongdae (about 8.6 km) and Yeouido (about 9.9 km).
On arrival day：You can spend a relaxed arrival day at the Seoul Botanic Park greenhouse and on a walk by its lake.
flow: Arrival
At both Terminal 1 and Terminal 2, we wait at the arrivals hall exit on the 1st floor with a board showing your name.
Ride
We load your luggage and head to your Magok hotel. It is 44.3 km from Terminal 1, about 41 minutes without traffic.
Hotel
Drop-off at the hotel entrance. You can spend a relaxed arrival day at the Seoul Botanic Park greenhouse and on a walk by its lake.
faq: Can I communicate in Japanese?
Yes. From booking to contact on the day, we can help you in Japanese on LINE. Drivers also speak simple Japanese on the day.
What happens if my flight is delayed?
We track your flight's arrival time and wait for you. There is no extra charge for delays.
How can I pay?
You can pay on the day in cash (won or yen) or by credit card.
Is there a cancellation fee?
Cancellation is free up to the day before. Same-day cancellations are charged 50% of the price.
